text.content:
Proud and selfless, Guardians will sacrifice themselves for a person, nation or ideal they have sworn to protect.

SKILLS

SHIELD MASTERY · SL max 5

When you use the Guard action with a shield equipped, your Guard value increases by (SL).

PROTECTING OTHERS · SL max 3

When an ally you can see within 3 squares of you would suffer damage or a negative status effect, you may use a reaction and move up to 3 squares towards them. If you reach them, you reduce their damage or negate their status effect.

LAST STAND · SL max 3

When you reach 0 Hit Points and have not yet been defeated in this conflict, you remain standing with 1 Hit Point instead. You may do this a number of times per conflict equal to (SL).

AEGIS · SL max 2

When you use the Guard action, one ally you can see within 3 squares of you gains Guard value equal to (SL × 2) until the end of the scene.

INSPIRE · SL max 3

When an ally you can see uses an action during their turn, you may use a reaction to grant them a +2 bonus to their next Check.
